cohort: Participants were patients presenting to Labor and Delivery in early labor, at 37 weeks' gestation or greater, who were either 3-4 cm dilated, in early labor with rupture of membranes less than 12 hours, or induced for oligohydramnios or postdates gestation.
finding: Maternal lactate levels significantly increase within 30 minutes of pushing after complete cervical dilation, with this increase being more pronounced in patients with chorioamnionitis.
